about: Per-game env defaults for games on the Mali system driver (Blobferry bridge), read by droiddeck-mali-defaults at every game start. Keys: steam:<app id> or <store>:<store id> (never a per-install Steam shortcut id). Only env applies; pending entries are documented candidates and are never applied. The user's own game settings and shared settings always win key by key; BL_MALI_GAME_DEFAULTS=0 turns all of it off. Every game's global D3D12 defaults come from the app (GameEnvironment.defaults: VKD3D_FEATURE_LEVEL=12_1, VKD3D_SHADER_MODEL=6_6, no VKD3D_CONFIG, no GPU vendor spoof, no nvapi); an entry here only adds what that game needs to start or a measured winner (docs/agents/env-defaults-1106.md).

env.DXVK_CONFIG: d3d11.maxTessFactor = 1; d3d11.samplerAnisotropy = 1; d3d11.invariantPosition = True; d3d11.relaxedBarriers = True; dxvk.numCompilerThreads = 4

steam:292030.evidence: DX11 keys: the 11-01 pack + threads dxvk-cs,MainThread + its DXVK_CONFIG (defaults.md § 2, witcher3.md). VKD3D_CONFIG=nodxr (DX12 build only; vkd3d ignores it under DX11): on the phone's 292030 entry in every DX12 run since the 11-05 12:46 switch (witcher3.md l.383; w3-uncap, w3-towncpu, witcher-fbnarrow), not A/B-tested alone. FEX_EXTENDEDVOLATILEMETADATA (the town loop ranges of witcher3.exe, so FEX keeps TSO-off code there): witcher-tsofix-1106 L2 (11-06 11:45-12:00), RenderThread 88.3 -> 58.0 Mcyc/frame (-34 %), STAND 33.1 fps uncapped, 0 major flashes; witcher3.md l.768-777. Env only, works with the shipped FEX DLL a2448b03. MALI_COMPAT_FB_MASK=0x0d6 (the DX12 terrain-flash fix): witcher-fbnarrow 11-05, 0 major flashes in 600 s (P 0.012), cost -0.5 % fps / +3.4 GPU-busy points at the 30 cap; kept on the phone's 292030 entry (winner rule, HANDOFF 11-06 11:32). Needs compat layer 3f7cf69cb5dc47af204835750cf55486 or later with FB_MASK (de6e975d ignores it). Open: passorder-1106 L1 saw 4 major flashes in the first daylight clip with the same 0x0d6 mask built in (HANDOFF 11-06 13:50); the built-in was reverted (bridge c1de5b2), so the key stays until the daylight case is understood.

The RTX 2080 device id/name is the compat layer's default for 10de when MALI_COMPAT_DEVICE_ID/NAME are unset (mali_compat_layer.c apply_properties_overrides). The game does not reach gameplay yet (dv1106 D1: exits on the loading screen); MALI_COMPAT_BUDGET_MB, FEX_STRICTINPROCESSSPLITLOCKS and MALI_WSI_FPS from the phone entry are not measured needs and are left out.
